en.t: It seemed that today he was in terrible agony.

units.source_text: 我多方抚慰，他却来回“唔唔，嗯嗯”的，不知这是回答，还是喘息。

en.t: I tried to comfort him in every way, but he only kept going back and forth with "uhh, mm-hmm," and I could not tell whether it was an answer or his breathing.

units.source_text: 那断断续续的难受的呻吟声，一直在我的脑海里盘旋。

en.t: Those broken, painful groans kept circling in my mind.

units.source_text: 我无比心酸，宛如自己的生命一寸寸被剁下扔掉似的。

en.t: My heart ached beyond measure, as if my own life were being chopped away inch by inch and thrown aside.
